respuesta.pregunta: What changed in the rule_row table columns between 0.2.2 and latest of 2p-revenue-optimizer-api?
respuesta.respuesta:
The only difference is the `custom_fields` column. In 0.2.2, the rule_row table lists `custom_fields` as type json, Null, with the description "Custom Fields" [2p-revenue-optimizer-api/0.2.2/guide/pages/table_data_dictionary/rule_row.md:L16-L16]. The latest rule_row table doesn't list that column. Its last column is `item` [2p-revenue-optimizer-api/latest/guide/pages/table_data_dictionary/rule_row.md:L15-L16].

All the other columns are the same in both versions:
- `id`: bigint, Not null, auto-increment primary key
- `rule_id`: bigint, Not null, foreign key that REFERENCES rule_header(id)
- `site_id`, `seller_id`, `domain`, `brand` and `item`: json, Null

[2p-revenue-optimizer-api/0.2.2/guide/pages/table_data_dictionary/rule_row.md:L9-L15] [2p-revenue-optimizer-api/latest/guide/pages/table_data_dictionary/rule_row.md:L9-L15]

Latest also documents a separate `rule_custom_field` table [2p-revenue-optimizer-api/latest/guide/pages/table_data_dictionary/rule_custom_field.md:L1-L1]. It has a `rule_row_id` column (bigint, Not null) that REFERENCES rule_row(id), plus `name` and `value_info` columns (both varchar(180), Not null) [2p-revenue-optimizer-api/latest/guide/pages/table_data_dictionary/rule_custom_field.md:L9-L12]. The documentation doesn't say whether this table replaces the old `custom_fields` column.
answer_checks: Calls the tool with version=null even though the question names two versions.
Attributes the custom_fields column (json, Null) only to 0.2.2 and does not present it as part of the latest rule_row table.
States that the columns id, rule_id, site_id, seller_id, domain, brand and item are unchanged between both versions.
Cites the rule_row.md documents of both 0.2.2 and latest.
Does not claim, without support, that custom_fields was removed or replaced by another table in latest; at most it notes that this is not documented.
